//secrets: No secrets in this file. Development values live in appsettings.Development.json; every other environment supplies them through the environment (Jwt__Key, ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, Stripe__SecretKey). StartupConfigValidator refuses to start when any of them is missing, and also when a value committed to this repository reaches a non-Development environment.

Retention.//: Clears stored request payloads once a tenant's RetentionDays entitlement has passed. OFF by default: a service should not start deleting customer data because it was upgraded. Payload-only unless DeleteJobRows is set, so usage, billing and audit history survive.
